scope: Real sandbox namespaces, CONNECT/SOCKS5, deterministic DNS/TLS peers and the published Python SDK on a local Linux kernel under Docker Desktop; no external traffic or density measurement
egressCoverage: HTTPS proxy environment with verified fixture certificate
CONNECT and SOCKS5 binary relay and half-close
UDP DNS truncation and TCP fallback
Domain denial before DNS, public-address filtering and per-connection rebinding checks
Bounded global connections, parent close and cancellation during DNS
Structured decision logs and daemon namespace ownership
Published Python SDK 1.1.0 policy and HTTPS
Daemon loss, old workload containment and fresh-epoch recovery

earlierFailures.kind: Daemon executable lookup after mount-namespace isolation lost the mounted path prefix
earlierFailures.resolution: Resolve and verify the executable before cloning the mount namespace; verify the retained path again at runtime startup

earlierFailures.kind: Internal Unix bridge address exceeded sockaddr_un length under a long runtime path
earlierFailures.resolution: Bind and connect relative to an owned protected directory descriptor through /proc/self/fd

earlierFailures.kind: SDK probe resolved its virtualenv interpreter symlink to the system interpreter
SDK probe tried to forget records already collected by SDK sandbox deletion
earlierFailures.resolution: Verify the existing lifecycle by observing 404 for the released session and commands

buildEnvironment: Initial direct Cargo tests against a Windows bind-mounted /source failed three existing protected-path tests; the official Docker COPY-based Rust lane passed all tests without changing those guards.
